meaning: Independent source-derived verification of v1/v2/v3 typed Mapping field projections, not factory construction or discovered computation.
inputs: Normalize all explicit inputs before projections, including unused inputs and required nullable formals. Exercise zero and multiple inputs, all admitted scalar/named/optional/list/set/sum/qualified-public shapes, exact UInt64 carriers, malformed inert data, missing optional fields and distinct source identities. Never use factory-owned witnesses or execute validators.
defaults: V1 falls back only for absent source fields; explicit null remains null. Partial absent optional fields are omitted and total missing-source fields reject MAPPING_REQUIRED_VALUE. V2/v3 use declared lazy nullish fallback after complete input normalization. Preserve existing MAPPING_INPUT, RULE_INPUT and INTERFACE_VALUE error boundaries.
outputs: Observe exact authored field order and complete selected fields, actual primitive carriers, nested normalization, deep freezing and detachment from caller objects without reading getters or serialization hooks. Preserve Entity identity, Value Object structural equality, qualified public contract identity, list order/multiplicity and canonical set uniqueness/first representative. No implicit optional traversal, reference lookup, factory or invariant execution.
bindings: Observe frozen inert constructor descriptors and checked source contracts, inputs, targets, field mappings, explicit member-use bindings and original provider/import identities. Public contracts stay qualified structural values, never synthetic domain records or nominal runtime brands.
effects: Inspect exact source and emitted Mapping/Interface-only closures using separately bound native AST auditing and exact native import guards. Retain every Mapping in source audits even if finite cases are unmet. Reject forbidden forms/ambient identifiers, except erased type-only identifiers; reject Object mutation APIs and direct prototype freezing. Bind observation phase, inventory, hashes and audit artifacts before execution and invalidate evidence after late drift. This is bounded syntactic restriction, not universal purity or arbitrary Proxy/modified-intrinsic isolation.
bounds: 4096 per-node cases and fact expansion, depth 64, 65536 project cases and 8 MiB serialized controls. Entire node becomes not_evaluable on finite budget exhaustion; no passing prefix. AST bounds 1000000 visits per module and depth 512; descriptor walk 65536 visits and depth 64.
compatibility: Preserve all 52 predecessor capsule sources, domain generators, source schemas, existing semantic/effect checks, exact native profiles and all R08-R18 completion requirements. No SFOL, AlchLang, dependency installation, provider effects, publication, admission or default cutover.
